summary: # Introduction of New Features in CLO2024.0: Experience a More Powerful Knitting Performance! ## Overview Hello everyone, I am Celia. Today, Andy and I will introduce you to the new features of Closet 2024.0. This time, the new features mainly include nine aspects: the main functions, documents, 2D, 3D, virtual models, materials, modes, rendering, and Closet. This live broadcast is divided into two stages. In the first half, I will introduce the first four aspects to you, and the latter part will be explained by Andy. Let's start today's introduction. ## Main Features of the Update ### Account Collection First of all, I will introduce the main features of the update. The first is about account collection. From the 2024 version, individual users can now visit all products of Closet through a collection account. The collection account means that users can use all services and software provided by Closet without needing to register individually using their personal email accounts. When you log in using the collection account, you will use your email to automatically log in to all Closet-related services, including Closet software, Closet platform, Connect Business, Marvelous Designer, and Genie, instead of logging in through your user ID. Using the collection account can make your work process smoother. In addition, by using the Closet account, you can greatly reduce the risk of multi-account management and easily manage and update account information on a single page. Even if the account is collected, all data, assets, and subscriptions in the existing account will remain unchanged. You can continue to download and use software licenses and purchase projects. Currently, the collection account is only used for individual users. Enterprise users do not need to take any additional actions. For new users, the collection account will be automatically created when they register. ### Operation Process for Existing Users Next, let's take a look at the operation process of the collection account for existing users. For existing users, the current account will be merged according to your registered email address. When logging in from the Closet software, use the existing license ID and password to log in to the login window. At this time, a collection account creation window will appear. Click the OK button to enter the Closet login page. Click "Create Account" to complete the mobile phone number verification and agree to the terms and conditions. You will use the Closet license ID and password you entered to create a collection account. If you have registered a Closet account using the same email address, Closet will automatically match the email address and convert it into a unified collection account. If Closet does not recognize the account registered with the same email address, it will create a Closet account and convert it into a collection account. If you use the Closet software and Closet simultaneously but with different email addresses, in this case, you can connect to the email account you choose. If you integrate the existing Closet account with the Closet account, you can use the files stored and downloaded in the account in the original way. If you want to connect to the Closet account you are using, you can contact us to help you merge the email addresses related to your account. In the future, we will also develop this feature so that users can connect directly. After completing the conversion of the collection account, you can automatically log into the Closet software by saving the ID and password as before. Additionally, you can also create a collection account for existing users on the Closet official website. Visit the Closet official website and click the Login button. Log in with your existing Closet ID and password. At this time, the window that will create and generate your collection account will appear. Click the Confirm button. Once the collection account is digitized, it is taken to the Closet account. When entering the Closet login window, complete the collection account. After the update of the 2024 version, you only need to perform the above operations when you first connect and set up the integrated account. After the conversion is complete, there will be no more account integration. Finally, if you want to use an email account, you must use the same email address in all cloud services. If you have any questions, you can check the help center website related to the integrated account in the video description. Using the integrated account, you will collaborate with all cloud services and easily manage your account information on one page. ## New Material Features ### Needle Clothing We have been researching and developing to change the appearance and performance of cloud-based needle products. Previously, we had to create various stickers manually based on the texture or material to express the needle structure. From the new version, the material type has been added with the option of needle clothing, which will start from the structure of the needle product to help us show the appearance of the needle product more realistically. Since the needle organization is expressed by the grid, it is very natural to simulate. Select a piece of needle in the software. In the bottom attribute editor, an option for needle clothing has been added in the material type. Add the material type to change to needle clothing. At this time, the attribute editor will also be adjusted to the option of needle clothing used in the new version. After modifying the settings, you can check the change effect in the 3D window. First of all, we can switch between different preset needles. In order to truly show the texture of the needle and thread, the surface of the needle and thread is also applied to the hairline sticker. If you delete the hairline sticker, you can see that the shadow of the edge thread will become lighter. You can use Ctrl-Z to withdraw the action. In addition, you can also set the number of threads used on each bone thread. You can set the value between 1 and 6. Below, you can see that the colors of each bone thread can be set. Click on the color card on the right to set different colors for each bone thread. To naturally express the seam of the needle and thread clothing, we use the option of creating a seam by default. By creating a thread line on the sewing line connected to the sewing line and the outside of the board, the needle and thread of the whole clothing can be naturally realized. The length of the seam curve can be used to control the seam length beyond the extension to the board. The lower the number, the shorter the seam length, and the longer the length of the needle and thread. If the seam curve is reduced under the use of the deep seam option, the seam line and the outside of the board will become even. The needle and thread will be turned to the opposite side of the board. As mentioned earlier, the needle and thread clothing has a grid structure, so it will affect 3D operation and rendering speed. Especially, the higher the density of the embroidery, the more the grid is calculated, the greater the impact on speed. Therefore, after completing the attribute of the needle and thread clothing, you can use the needle and thread clothing to control the speed in the 3D window. Next, we will pre-use the fabric made by the needle and thread clothing preset to be applied to the clothes separately. Open the rendering to see the rendering result. You can see that the performance of the needle and thread clothing is now more natural and rich than before. ### Storage and Export Options In addition to needle and thread clothing, you can also control the speed in the 3D window. Needle and thread clothing is a material that can only be used in clothes, so it is difficult to extract it as an external expansion format such as OBJ, FBX, or GLTF, or to store it as an image. Therefore, you can store the needle and thread clothing you process as a project file or as a ZFAB file to save it. By using this technology, the visual effect of needle and thread clothing has been greatly improved. You can easily create more realistic needle and thread fabrics by adjusting the preset and settings of various needle and thread clothing. If you have any thoughts or opinions on needle and thread clothing, please scan the QR code. Your feedback will further help us optimize the needle and thread clothing function. ## User Interface Updates ### Cloud User Interface From the 2024.0 version, the user interface of Cloud starts to update. The new version of the interface becomes more intuitive and efficient, and the user experience is improved. First is the overall update of the Cloud color system. The overall color and text of this software have been updated. ### File Opening Dialogue Box The update of the file opening dialogue box includes the DXF file as an example. In the DXF window, the selected frame is displayed in blue, which is more intuitive and easy to understand. In the main menu, when the mouse hovers over the required content, not only the file name of the menu can be seen, but also the menu itself will show more intuitively. Additionally, the icon design in the software has become clearer and easier to distinguish visually. This time, the icons in the 2D toolbar, 3D toolbar, and the object window have been updated. Also, the icon in the visually productive tool tab is divided into open and save icons on the right side. ### Icon Layout Optimization The display of the field card and the side view is now also clearer. The update has also optimized the icon layout of the 2D and 3D windows. In the new version, users can only use the corresponding icon to open or close each topic, making it easier to determine which display view in the menu is activated or stopped. After the new version is improved, users can now directly control the display status of 3D and 2D viewing views. Similarly, in the upper left corner of the 3D and 2D windows, you can see the icon that displays the switch.
